integrity: Derives Green-kernel identities analytically, includes direct grounded-Laplacian rational checks, and does not represent finite checks or this self-review as independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only real canonical orthogonal edge-space projections and n>=4. The full Möbius-ladder pseudoinverse was previously published; novelty is confined to the strict extremizing edge orbit, exact absolute-column sums and sharp logarithmic finite-size coefficient. Equivalent prior analyses may exist.
title: Sharp logarithmic endpoint-projection deficit on Möbius ladders
